caption: A lighter is struck in a dark garage and held up, and the small flame lights the nearby tools and bench.

sa.check: A lighter is struck in a garage.
The flame lights the nearby tools and bench.

pc.expect: Only things near the flame are visible, lit from the flame's direction.
pc.fail: The far wall is as bright as the bench; or the near tools stay dark; or the light comes from elsewhere.

pc.expect: The light is warm and flickers with the flame.
pc.fail: It is steady white; or a different colour; or the tools change colour rather than brightness.

pc.expect: The lit area moves only with the lighter and would go out when it closes.
pc.fail: It drifts with the lighter still; or stays lit after the flame is out; or appears before the strike.
It points down or sideways in still air; or detaches; or floats.
A second flame appears; or the lighter vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bench and tools stay the same.
pc.fail: Tools rearrange; or the bench changes; or the lighter changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
